deleted.description: content IDs whose bytes were actually deleted

untagged.description: tag refs removed; disk freed only when the last tag/content GCs

cached.description:
Cached is true when this report was served from the TTL cache rather than
probed for this request.

deleted.description: content-hash IDs whose bytes were freed

untagged.description: refs whose tag was removed but content may remain

next_age_out.description:
NextAgeOut is the soonest a currently-kept record could become
age-deletable; the scheduler waits until then (or a usage event). Zero
means nothing is on an age path.

reason.description: in_use | pinned | keep_n_recent | within_max_age | grace | age_gc_disabled

pinned_at.description: zero for pins stored before entries carried a timestamp

last_used.description: the last-USED signal; zero => never observed used

pinned.description: explicit pin on this exact ref

ref.description: full local ref incl. tag, e.g. "cache.local/team/app:1.2"

grace_until.description: age deletion held off until then

running.description: a GC pass is executing right now

last_event_at.description: receipt time of the last usage event

reconnects.description: times the event stream ended and was re-established

copy_referrers.description:
Copy the source's referrer artifacts (notation signatures) into `to` with
the source digest preserved, so the image still verifies against the cache.
Requires copying all platforms (the request must not narrow `platforms`).
Defaults to true when verification is enabled and `to` is a copy-mode store.

distribute.description: Engine store names that should pull the image afterwards.

from.description: Source registry store name or host; defaults to the ref's registry.

platforms.description: Platforms to move; defaults to the server platform when empty.

to.description: Destination registry store to copy into; empty means engines pull from `from` directly.

keep_n.description: Override how many most-recent tags to keep per repo; 0 disables keep-N.

max_age.description: Override max image age (Go duration, e.g. "720h"); "0s" disables age GC.

pins.description: Override the pinned references exempt from GC.

in_use.description:
InUse mixes tag references and image IDs (sha256:...), exactly as live
containers reference them.

pattern.description: Doublestar pattern, matched against the full ref, name:tag, and the bare tag.

ref.description: Exact image reference to pin or unpin.
Image reference to delete from the engine store (required).
Image reference the engine store should pull (required).

pull.description: engine can be triggered to pull

error.description: engine readiness error, if not ready

ready.description: registries: always true (from config); engines: live Ready() probe

digest.description: manifest/index digest the step was anchored to

kind.description: which store kind ran this step

info.description:
Move container images between stores (OCI registries and docker/containerd engines) and track per-layer progress.
A job copies an image `from` an OCI store `to` another, then `distribute` engines pull it.
info.title: gantry API

get.description: Aggregate readiness over the gated stores (serve.health.ready_stores; defaults to every engine store, so a flaky remote upstream cannot flap the node). 200 when all gated stores are healthy, 503 otherwise. Unauthenticated like /healthz, but the per-store breakdown is included only for authenticated callers.

Scheduler observability: when GC last ran and will next wake, whether the post-startup grace window is holding age deletion off, the effective default policy, and per-engine index sizes. Never probes live daemons.

post.description: Move an image: copy `from` (oci) into `to` (oci), then have the `distribute` engines pull it, anchored to the digest the copy committed. Idempotent per identical move.

Location.description: canonical URL of the created job (/v1/job/{id})

get.description: Streams Server-Sent Events: repeated `event: progress` frames each carrying a JSON warm.JobSnapshot in `data:`, ending with a terminal `event: done` frame. With ?wait=<dur> it instead long-polls and returns a single JSON warm.JobSnapshot (no SSE framing) once the job is terminal or the wait elapses.
Configured stores with their kind, capabilities, and readiness.

Returns the retention decision (keep/delete) without deleting anything. An optional body overrides the configured max_age/keep_n/pins for this call. NOTE: a GET request body is dropped by fetch()/XHR, some HTTP clients, and proxies — to pass overrides reliably, use POST.
get.summary: Evaluate retention GC for a store (dry-run)

post.description: Applies the deletions and returns the apply result. An optional body overrides the configured max_age/keep_n/pins for this call.
post.summary: Run retention GC for a store (apply)

get.description: Probes one store's reachability (an engine daemon ready-check, or a registry GET /v2/ ping) and returns the result. The probe is cached for a short TTL (serve.health.cache_ttl, default 5s); a cached response sets `cached: true`. Returns 200 when healthy, 503 when unhealthy (report body either way), 404 for an unknown store.

delete.description: Purges one record from the retention index WITHOUT touching the engine — the escape hatch for orphan records left by out-of-band image removal. A record for an image still present is re-created (with fresh timestamps) by the usage watcher or the next distribute. To delete the image itself use /remove.

get.description: The retention index records for an engine store — what gantry believes is on the node and the timestamps driving GC decisions (last_used, last_distributed, first_seen, pinned).
The references and image IDs running containers use right now — GC's top protection tier, as ground truth (probed live, not from the index).
get.summary: List images live containers hold on an engine

get.description: Pins are exempt from retention GC: exact references, or doublestar patterns matched against the full ref, its name:tag short form, and the bare tag.
get.summary: List pinned references for a store

post.description: Body carries exactly one of `ref` (exact) or `pattern` (doublestar; matched against the full ref, name:tag, and the bare tag). Preview the effect with the GC dry-run — a broad pattern like `**` disables age GC entirely.
post.summary: Pin a reference or pattern (exempt from GC)

post.description: Tells one engine store to pull a reference, decoupled from the job pipeline (manual reconcile). Stamps the retention index like a job's distribute step, so the pulled image stays eligible for age GC.
post.summary: Trigger an engine store to pull

post.description: Manually deletes one image from an engine store and syncs the retention index.
post.summary: Remove an image from an engine store

get.description: Liveness of the engine's usage-event stream. A dead stream freezes last-used times and silently degrades age GC — alert on connected=false or a stale last_event_at.
The running binary's version stamp, for remote fleet inventory during rolling upgrades.
